feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 August 2026 10:48pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 28 August 2026 at 10:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure centre to the east of Scotland, with another low centre moving eastwards into southwest England tomorrow.


##Wind##

West 3 or 4, falling Variable 2 to 4 later tonight. Gradually settling East or Northeast 3 or 4 through tomorrow morning and afternoon, backing North or Northwest in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then outbreaks of rain and drizzle spreading from the south tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain and drizzle tomorrow.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 3 or 4, backing South or Southwest overnight into Sunday, increasing South or Southeast 4 or 5 on Sunday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Rain and drizzle clearing, then showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain, drizzle or showers.
